content: Attention has been widely used in pair-classification problems like natural language inference. Wang et al. BIBREF5 introduced BIMPM which matched one sequence with another in four different fashion but one single matching function which they used as cosine. Liu et al. BIBREF6 proposed SAN for language inference which also used dot-product attention between the sequences.
